gloss: staggered work hours; flexible commuting times

definitions.gloss: staggered work hours; commuting outside rush hour
definitions.explanation: a work arrangement where employees start and end work at non-standard times to avoid rush hour congestion

notes:
USAGE:
Starting and finishing work earlier or later than usual to avoid the rush-hour crowds (⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧). Many companies encouraged it during the COVID-19 pandemic, and railways promote it as オフピーク⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (off-peak commuting).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フレックス→フレックス：23314_furekkusu⟧⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ - flextime: employees set their own hours within limits. {時差出勤|じさしゅっきん} usually shifts a fixed schedule rather than letting employees choose.
